request.subject: PORTRAIT:MARTIAN:FIGHTER

layers.text: Add three small glowing hot magenta lights, colour #ff2fb0: the ball on the tip of the antenna becomes a bigger hot magenta ball, the muzzle of the pistol glows hot magenta, and one round hot magenta light sits on the chest of the suit. Do not redraw anything else: keep the head, the big black eyes, the glass bubble helmet, the silver suit, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
